declaration.preface:
PEWSPL is committed to maintaining a workplace that respects human rights, promotes fair labour practices, and provides equal opportunity, dignity, and respect to all employees and stakeholders. The Company believes that ethical employment practices, safe working conditions, diversity, inclusion, and employee well-being are essential for sustainable business growth and responsible business conduct.

PEWSPL is committed to complying with applicable labour laws, human rights principles, and employment regulations across all its operations. The Company strives to prevent discrimination, harassment, child labour, forced labour, and any form of unfair treatment while promoting a safe, inclusive, and respectful work environment.
declaration.declaration:
The purpose of this policy is to identify, assess, and manage human rights that impacts our business activities in the operational context, our leverage and business relationships. It aims to enhance the knowledge and understanding of human rights, foster attitudes of tolerance, respect, solidarity, and responsibility amongst PEWSPL employees. The policy aims to:

Promote fair labour practices and responsible employment conditions.

Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and human rights requirements.

Prevent child labour, forced labour, discrimination, harassment, and unfair treatment.

Promote equal opportunity, diversity, inclusion, and workplace dignity.

Maintain safe, healthy, and respectful working conditions.

Encourage employee well-being, engagement, and ethical workplace behaviour.

Foster awareness and accountability regarding labour rights and workplace conduct.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all operations of PEWSPL, including transportation activities, operational facilities, warehouses, and office locations across all locations where PEWSPL operates. It covers all permanent, temporary, and contractual employees across all functions, as well as all internal and external stakeholders associated with PEWSPL, whether directly or indirectly engaged with the organization’s operations and services.

focusAreas: Fair Employment Practices & Responsible Working Conditions

Workplace Health, Safety & Operational W: We are committed to maintaining safe, hygienic, and healthy working conditions across warehouses, transportation activities, and office facilities.
We aim to minimize workplace risks and unsafe practices through responsible operational controls and safety procedures.
We strive to strengthen employee awareness regarding workplace safety, emergency preparedness, and responsible operational behaviour.
We are committed to promoting safe material handling, warehouse operations, and transportation practices across all applicable functions.
We seek to support employee well-being through safe working environments and responsible workplace practices.
We strive to strengthen workplace health and safety management practices in alignment with applicable ISO 45001 Occupational Health & Safety Management System requirements.
We aim to conduct timely safety awareness initiatives and emergency response preparedness programs to support employees in identifying and managing workplace risks.
We are committed to maintaining a workplace free from unsafe behaviour, violence, substance abuse, and practices that may negatively impact the workplace environment.
Human Rights Protection & Ethical Employ: We are committed to strictly prohibiting child labour, forced labour, bonded labour, and all forms of human trafficking across our operations.
We aim to ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, minimum age requirements, and ethical employment practices.
We strive to maintain responsible recruitment, employment verification, and workforce management procedures.
We are committed to promoting awareness regarding ethical labour practices and responsible employment standards.
We will encourage responsible labour practices across contractors, manpower providers, and business partners associated with the Company.
We are committed to maintaining a zero-tolerance approach towards modern slavery and human trafficking across our operations and supply chain relationships.
We strive to ensure that employees work voluntarily and are free to terminate employment in accordance with applicable employment conditions and legal requirements.
Employee Communication & Grievance Manag: We are committed to promoting transparent communication and respectful workplace interactions across the organization.
We aim to encourage employees to report workplace concerns, grievances, or operational issues through appropriate reporting channels.
We strive to maintain fair, transparent, and confidential grievance handling mechanisms.
We are committed to promoting employee participation and engagement in workplace improvement initiatives wherever feasible.
We aim to foster a workplace culture based on mutual respect, collaboration, and responsible communication.
We are committed to fostering positive employee relations through open communication, employee engagement, and constructive interaction with workforce representatives.
We strive to create workplaces in which open and honest communication among employees is encouraged and respected.
We are committed to ensuring that employees can raise workplace concerns without fear of retaliation or unfair treatment.
Training, Skill Development & Career Gro: We are committed to supporting employee learning, skill development, and professional growth opportunities.
We aim to strengthen employee capabilities through operational, safety, behavioural, and policy awareness training programs.
We strive to promote continuous learning and responsible workplace behaviour across all operational functions.
We are committed to encouraging employee participation in training and awareness initiatives relevant to their roles and responsibilities.
We seek to support workforce competency and operational efficiency through regular capability-building initiatives.
We strive to continuously develop and integrate relevant workplace awareness and human rights topics into employee training programs.
We are committed to promoting awareness regarding ethical conduct, labour rights, and responsible workplace practices across the organization.
Fair Employment Practices & Responsible: We are committed to maintaining fair and responsible working conditions across all business operations.
We aim to ensure compliance with applicable labour laws relating to wages, working hours, leave, and employee benefits.
We strive to promote ethical employment practices and respectful workplace behaviour across all levels of the organization.
We are committed to maintaining transparent employment practices and responsible workforce management procedures.
We will support a positive and professional work environment that promotes employee dignity and respect.
We are committed to promoting work-life balance and responsible workplace practices wherever operationally feasible.
We strive to maintain open and direct communication with employees regarding workplace concerns, employment conditions, and employee rights.
Inclusive Workplace & Anti-Harassment Pr: We are committed to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination, harassment, bullying, abuse, intimidation, or unfair treatment.
We aim to promote equal opportunity, dignity, inclusion, and mutual respect across all levels of the organization.
We strive to encourage respectful workplace behaviour and responsible professional conduct.
We are committed to maintaining fair and transparent processes for reporting and addressing workplace concerns.
We aim to strengthen employee awareness regarding workplace behaviour, inclusion, and anti-harassment practices.
We strive to maintain an inclusive work culture in which employees feel respected, valued, and supported in their professional growth.
We are committed to promoting equal opportunity in recruitment, training, development, compensation, and career advancement based on qualifications, skills, and performance.
Employee Welfare, Inclusion & Well-Being: We are committed to promoting employee well-being and responsible workplace welfare practices across all operations.
We aim to support a positive, inclusive, and respectful work environment for employees.
We strive to encourage employee engagement, work-life balance, and responsible workplace interactions wherever feasible.
We are committed to supporting employee welfare initiatives and awareness programs across operational facilities.
We seek to promote employee morale, dignity, and overall workplace well-being through responsible management practices.
We strive to support employee well-being through responsible workplace practices, access to basic welfare facilities, and healthy workplace environments.
We are committed to encouraging workplace practices that support employee health, hygiene, and general well-being across operations.

policy.monitoring:
Implementation of this Social Responsibility Policy shall be monitored through periodic reviews, employee feedback, workplace inspections, compliance assessments, and grievance management mechanisms. Labour-related concerns, incidents, and corrective actions shall be tracked and reviewed regularly.

PEWSPL is committed to continually improving labour and human rights practices through regular review of workplace standards, employee awareness initiatives, grievance mechanisms, and compliance processes. The Company will continue strengthening fair employment practices, employee well-being, and workplace culture in line with legal requirements and responsible business commitments.
policy.reviewMechanism: This Social Responsibility Policy shall be reviewed annually by the Human Resources Department or whenever significant changes occur in labour laws, operational activities, workforce structure, stakeholder expectations, or organizational requirements, to ensure its continued relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with the Company’s human rights and fair labour commitments.
